title: SDK surface launch: coordinated sample distribution, docs embargo, and telemetry gating
creator: Aisha Patel
project: SDK API Launch - Function Calling + Structured Streaming
description:
Goal: coordinate a staged rollout of SDK surface changes (function-calling v2, structured output schemas, streaming SDK behavior) with embargoed sample kits and telemetry gating so customers and integrators receive deterministic, well-tested samples at the same time as public docs.

Why this ticket exists:
- Past launches exposed mismatches between docs, language samples, and the hosted API behavior (edge-case streaming tokens and function call schema).
- To reduce support load and regressions, we will gate public sample distribution behind telemetry confirms (first 48-hour smoke + sample-run metrics), and deliver localized sample kits to key partners under embargo for early integration testing.

Scope in this ticket:
- Finalize canonical code samples across Go, Python, and JavaScript (server + browser streaming variants).
- Prepare an embargoed sample bundle for partners and internal SEs (packaging + README + test harness).
- Draft release notes and a staged roll-out schedule for docs + SDK package publication.
- Implement telemetry gating criteria (key metrics described below) and coordinate rollout with runtime and infra teams to avoid breaking changes.

Out-of-scope for this ticket:
- Major SDK refactor beyond small compatibility shims (will be tracked in ENG sub-issues).

rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Partner Preview, days -7 to 0): distribute embargoed sample kit to 12 partners and internal SEs; collect integration feedback. Phase 1 (Staged Public Rollout, day 0): publish docs to staging, open SDK release to canary users (5% of orgs) and monitor telemetry. Phase 2 (Gradual Increase, days 1-7): escalate canary from 5% -> 25% -> 100% if telemetry gates pass at each step. Phase 3 (Post-Launch, days 8-30): collect bug reports, amend release notes FAQ, ship patch if needed. Rollback: if sample-run.error_rate > 3% or latency regression > 30% at any stage, pause rollout and revert SDK package versions to previous tag.
release_notes_draft:
Highlights:
- Function Calling v2: improved deterministic function selection and payload schema (see examples).
- Structured Output: added typed schema examples and validation guidance.
- Streaming SDKs: unified EOF semantics and new streaming examples for browser and server environments.

Migration notes:
- Check the new example for streaming EOF handling; update production code to handle onComplete events.
- If you rely on implicit JSON outputs, validate against the structured schema to avoid parsing regressions.

Known limitations:
- Language-specific client behavior around partial-message retries: we are tracking fixes in ENG-7391.
- Some partner environments require CORS headers for browser streaming; see troubleshooting.

Support plan:
- SE-runbooks and sample-kit troubleshooting guide included in Drive. Priority support window available for partners under NDA for first 14 days.
